He owns the house we currently live in, his (separated) wife's house, and a bar that has 2 apartments above it. I personally want nothing to do with the bar due it being a cause for my parent's alcoholism. My mom says I should just give it all to her if that's the case. I would ask her to at least buy out my half, but she has been mentally abusive to me for most of my life, and constantly sabotaged anything I've done to try and better my own life. I've recently thought about just selling my quarter of the house to my siblings, and the entire bar to them or anyone else who wants it. WIBTA if I decided to leave my mom out of anything I get from my dad's will?

But morally, is it wrong to exclude my mom from benefiting from these assets? She's been mentally abusive, which complicates things. On one hand, she's been a negative influence, and I don't want to give her any financial benefits. There's no easy answer, but understanding my own values can help guide the decision. In summary, the decision to sell my share of the assets and exclude my mom from benefiting from them involves legal, moral, emotional, and practical considerations. I need to weigh these factors carefully and perhaps seek advice from a legal or financial professional to ensure I'm making the best decision for my circumstances.
